title: US ISM Manufacturing PMI
desc: A foundational forward indicator of industrial health. The market is zeroing in on the 'Prices' index component; ongoing gains here reflect stubborn supply-chain or energy-driven input costs that reinforce the Fed's restrictive liquidity loop.

title: Eurozone Flash CPI Estimates
desc: The primary preliminary tracking metric for European inflation. A cool print completely solidifies expectations for an upcoming ECB policy easing cycle, structurally shifting relative yield pairs against the dollar.

title: US JOLTS Job Openings
desc: Initial high-frequency labor data drop for the month. It serves as a gauge of structural market tightening; a surprise contracture signals corporate hiring cools down, offering early cracks in the resilient employment layout.

title: US ADP Non-Farm Employment Change
desc: The private sector precursor to official labor department data. Serving as an early benchmark, any severe deviations from the expected 110k print will cause aggressive intraday positioning ahead of the weekend tape.

title: US ISM Non-Manufacturing Composite
desc: Tracks economic activity within the critical service sector economy. Since services are highly linked to wage-push inflation sticky behavior, this reading provides immediate context into underlying stagflation metrics.

title: US BLS Non-Farm Payrolls & Unemployment Rate
desc: The absolute highest volatility event of the week. Consensus anticipates a cooling addition of roughly 95k-96k jobs and an unemployment print at 4.3%. A hot payroll number (>150k) or surging average hourly earnings will violently price out near-term rate cut expectations and spike real yields.

title: Systemic Yield Premium Realignment
desc: Tracking weekend order-book depth to observe how capital reallocates out of the newly established Friday BLS payroll numbers. Thin weekend liquidity blocks amplify structural spot market moves.

title: BitLogic Alpha Net Liquidity Matrix Map
desc: Consolidating the fresh weekly trends of the contracting Fed balance sheet, TGA cash drains, and the newly established macro labor numbers into the Altcoin Season Index models for the month's trading ranges.
